world.status: Exploratory shared vocabulary; no canon, character pairing or owner style winner inferred.
world.premise: A sleek vertical city surrounds black-glass fault seams. Its abandoned transit cuts lead naturally through basalt wilderness into buried halls.
material_vocabulary: opaque black glass with restrained reflections
pale concrete and broad stone planes
brushed dark metal with functional joints
small sheltered moss or vegetation patches
controlled cyan seam light, not universal luminous ornament
world.ecological_rule: Intact seams hold usable charge and draw harmless seam-grazers. Fresh fractures leak pressure that attracts predators; ancient broken transit spines can feed something colossal.
world.social_rule: Combatants contest safe crossings and access to deeper charged ruins; competence, restraint and protective choices can be visible without assigning mundane occupations or a fixed party.
world.progression_rule: Desirable weapons channel clear present abilities with physical commitments; deeper seams promise stronger powers but do not remove stance, contact or route constraints.

comparison_styles.01: Dominant Nightglass: refined adult faces, crisp silhouette, limited soft modeling, wet vertical-city depth and selective cyan edge light.
comparison_styles.02: Sunbreak comparison: warm outlined painting with expressive faces and broad ochre/blue/green sunlit planes; dry upper terraces.
comparison_styles.06: Floodline comparison: graphic black-white brush masses with restrained hot pink; flooded lower cuts and clear concrete depth.

world.character_direction: Six new magnetic adult combat identities; modern clean tailoring plus purposeful armor, varied expressive faces and bodies. Predominantly light complexions are project appearance preferences, never quality scores. No reskinned anchor or previous cast.
world.scene_direction: Six complete environments carrying traversal, discovery, confrontation, combat, power and larger-threat moments. No component-board framing for scenes.
world.power_display: One present action or cue per image; progression promises remain separate text, not several simultaneous forms.

entries.title: The Missing Span
entries.caption: The city offers a route only to someone willing to commit.

His single saber and cropped petrol silhouette remain readable. One small Glassback Fox already stands safely on the landing ledge. Wet dark glass, pale concrete, brushed rails, a few distant window lights and moss at sheltered edges make an inhabited city; no crowd or extra giant creature. Back plates are smooth broad masses, not small decorative shards. It draws charge from a damaged transit spine and turns its massive head toward the disturbance.
